raw: {"title":"竖直圆周运动：最低点与最高点速度、张力、能量比较","domain":"circular","model_js":"globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample(input){const sc=(input&&input.scenario)||{};const angles=Array.isArray(input&&input.angles_rad)?input.angles_rad:[0];const mode=sc.mode;const m=+sc.mass_kg;const r=+sc.radius_m;const g=+sc.g_m_s2;const G=+sc.G_n_m2_kg2;const M=+sc.central_mass_kg;const v0=+sc.speed_m_s;const TAU=Math.PI*2;function num(x){return Number.isFinite(x)?x:0;}function stateUniform(th,v){const c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th);const ac=v*v/r;const ke=0.5*m*v*v;return{angle_rad:th,x_m:r*c,y_m:r*s,speed_m_s:v,ax_m_s2:-ac*c,ay_m_s2:-ac*s,radial_force_n:m*ac,tension_n:m*ac,kinetic_j:ke,potential_j:0,mechanical_j:ke};}function stateOrbit(th,v){const c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th);const ag=G*M/(r*r);const ke=0.5*m*v*v;const pe=-G*M*m/r;return{angle_rad:th,x_m:r*c,y_m:r*s,speed_m_s:v,ax_m_s2:-ag*c,ay_m_s2:-ag*s,radial_force_n:G*M*m/(r*r),tension_n:0,kinetic_j:ke,potential_j:pe,mechanical_j:ke+pe};}function vVert(th){const val=v0*v0-2*g*r*(1-Math.cos(th));return Math.sqrt(Math.max(val,1e-12));}function stateVertical(th){const c=Math.cos(th),s=Math.sin(th);const v=vVert(th);const ac=v*v/r;const at=-g*s;const x=r*s,y=-r*c;const ke=0.5*m*v*v;const pe=m*g*r*(1-c);return{angle_rad:th,x_m:x,y_m:y,speed_m_s:v,ax_m_s2:-ac*s+at*c,ay_m_s2:ac*c+at*s,radial_force_n:m*ac,tension_n:m*ac+m*g*c,kinetic_j:ke,potential_j:pe,mechanical_j:ke+pe};}let states=[],events={};if(mode===\"vertical_string\"){states=angles.map(stateVertical);const N=8192,h=TAU/N;let sum=h? (r/vVert(0)+r/vVert(TAU)):0;for(let i=1;i<N;i++){const th=i*h;sum+=(i%2?4:2)*(r/vVert(th));}const period=sum*h/3;events={period_s:num(period),centripetal_acceleration_m_s2:num(v0*v0/r),critical_top_speed_m_s:num(Math.sqrt(g*r)),critical_bottom_speed_m_s:num(Math.sqrt(5*g*r))};}else if(mode===\"orbit\"){const v=Math.sqrt(G*M/r);states=angles.map(function(th){return stateOrbit(th,v);});events={period_s:num(TAU*r/v),centripetal_acceleration_m_s2:num(G*M/(r*r))};}else{states=angles.map(function(th){return stateUniform(th,v0);});events={period_s:num(TAU*r/v0),centripetal_acceleration_m_s2:num(v0*v0/r)};}return{states:states,events:events};}});"}
